content:
Absolutely—happy to help. To tailor it, could you share:
- Goal of the email (e.g., request, update, follow-up, complaint, intro)
- Recipient and your relationship/title
- Key points that must be included (dates, numbers, attachments/links)
- Desired tone (formal, professional-friendly, casual)
- Call to action and timing (what you want them to do, by when)
- Any constraints (word count, sensitive topics, company style)

If it’s easier, fill these blanks:
- To/Role:
- Purpose:
- Background/context:
- 2–3 key points:
- CTA + deadline:
- Tone:
- Subject line preference (if any):

Quick starter template you can tweak:
Subject: [Clear, concise subject]

Hi [Name],

I’m reaching out to [state purpose in one line]. [One brief sentence of context if needed.]

Key details:
- [Point 1]
- [Point 2]
- [Point 3]

Could you please [specific request] by [date/timeframe]? I’m happy to provide [attachments/info] if helpful.

Thanks so much,
[Your Name]
[Title, Company]
[Phone | Optional]
